limits: Production drawVehicle method and its exact R predecessor; declared object with native 180×86 hull and native Canvas.
No browser journey, movement or saving is claimed by these rasters. Those controls belong to the separate 32/32 Node run.
Static hull only: occupied/damaged/destroyed states share the same image; no new hatch, propulsion, destruction or HADAL poses.
Any native Canvas getter change reproduced identically by R is recorded as an inherited state observation, not erased.

qualifications: Native Canvas and declared browser hosts; no Chromium journey.
16 distinct authored poses, two rendered orientations; native event-to-window checks are in the separate production tests.
Clip-dependent uniform scale caps raised actions at native stature; no per-frame stretch.
MANTA is a static original hull, with no new damage, propulsion, hatch or weapon animations.
Existing French labels without catalogue translations may remain French in the English fixture; the new disclosure is translated.
